untrustedForwarded.title: Forwarded headers from an untrusted address
untrustedForwarded.body: Bayplan got X-Forwarded headers from {{ip}}, which isn't in BAYPLAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES. They were ignored.

urlMismatch.title: Requests don't match the public URL
urlMismatch.body: Requests arrive for {{host}} over {{scheme}}, but the public URL is {{url}}. Sign-in and agent connections may fail.

webSocketFailing.title: WebSocket connections are failing
webSocketFailing.body: Agents or terminals can't connect through your proxy. Check that it passes the Upgrade headers.
